vibathons.place: UAlg TEC Campus, Penha campus, Faro

facts.text: A free day of building apps with AI, with Lovable, mentors, a jury and prizes. No coding needed. It sold out and opened a waiting list.
Organised by Algarve Evolution with Lovable, at the UAlg TEC Campus on the Penha campus in Faro, on 31 October 2026, from nine to six.
Registration was free; the event sold out and opened a waiting list.
The room filled with students, professionals, creatives and the curious, many with no coding experience at all.
Each participant got free Lovable credits, meals, an introduction to the tool and the day to build, with mentors and volunteers, and a jury and prizes at the end.
The crew's T-shirts carried the event's line: "Build something the Algarve world needs."
The opening thanked CRIA, the University of the Algarve's division for entrepreneurship and technology transfer, which runs the university's incubator.
António Guerreiro, executive director of Algarve Evolution, opened the day.
The projects built on the day, and the jury's winners, were not known when the article was written.

organisations.what: Waste company founded in 1995 and headquartered in Almancil, which serves the whole Algarve. With the start-up NILG.AI it built an AI tool that chooses sites for recycling points, piloted in Lagoa. UPTEC's page says the pilot also covers São Brás de Alportel.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 (FEDER) in the council's digitisation project
organisations.what: EU regional funding for digital infrastructure, online services and cybersecurity at the council.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 and Algarve Empreende 2026
organisations.what: Regional programme money behind Venture Lab, UAlg's proof-of-concept programme, and the AI and robotics pilot for 15 tourism SMEs.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 regional programme
organisations.what: Co-finances half of the more than 3.5 million euro Estádio Algarve technology centre and the Inova Algarve 3.0 AI and robotics pilot for tourism firms.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 regional programme (FEDER) in the Celeiro de Ideias centre
organisations.what: EU regional funding for the council's business and coworking centre.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 territorial incentive scheme (SIBT), notice ALGARVE-2026-5
organisations.what: A 5 million euro call for micro and small companies to create, expand or modernise, with up to 60 percent co-financing and special weight for inland, low-density territories. Priority areas include digitalisation and information and communication technologies. Applications are open until 15 January 2027, assessed in rounds ending 30 July, 30 October 2026 and 15 January 2027. The council posts the notice on its own site.

organisations.name: Algarve 6.0 Smart Territorial Hub (Alcoutim, Olhao, Loule, Sao Bras de Alportel, Tavira, Vila Real de Santo Antonio)
organisations.what: A PRR project of six municipalities to build an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network, including monitoring of isolated elderly residents. Alcoutim's assigned funding is 124.32 thousand euros, and the project is due to end on 30 June 2026.

organisations.name: Algarve AI Agents
organisations.what: An AI community that BeAlgarve's ecosystem directory lists for Faro and Loulé. We found no page of its own, so its activity is unverified.

organisations.name: Algarve Digital Innovators
organisations.what: Network of digital communities across the Algarve, supported by Algarve Evolution. Reported to include GDG Faro, Flutter Faro and Algarve AI Agents (our own newsroom's reading, to be re-checked at source).

organisations.name: Algarve Evolution
organisations.what: Association of entrepreneurs, talent and startups (106 active members by its own count) building an innovation ecosystem in the Algarve. Ran Vibathon Algarve 2026 in Faro on 31 October, runs the AI and Robotics programme for 15 tourism SMEs, and hosts events in Faro including one on UAlgTec Heritage on 17 November. Its pages do not state a base city.

organisations.name: Algarve Innovation and Technology Park (PPPITA), Pechão
organisations.what: Planned 48.58 hectare park in Pechão for technology companies, education and research, health and green space, with land for 548 public homes. A contract signed in August 2024 started its detailed plan, with 18 months for the landowner to finalise it. Whether it has progressed since is not confirmed.

organisations.name: Algarve Smart Destination, Digital Innovation Hub
organisations.what: An informal network led by the non-profit Algarve STP, in the European Commission's hub catalogue. Loulé is one of its three partner municipalities, with Faro and Olhão, alongside the University of the Algarve, ANJE, Algarve Evolution, Altis and Fraunhofer Portugal. Its focus areas include AI and deep learning for tourism and digital marketing. Found by detective.places@ and read by us on 16 November 2026.

organisations.name: Algarve STP
organisations.what: Science and technology park association that ran the first Venture Lab (12 firms, AI among the sectors) and co-hosted the July 2026 AI panel at UALG TEC Campus.

organisations.name: Altice Labs, Olhão hub
organisations.what: Altice Labs opened its Algarve hub in Olhão on 12 May 2021. Projects were already running, some with the University of Algarve, including AI algorithms for studying the retina.

organisations.name: AMAL, the Algarve intermunicipal community
organisations.what: The Algarve's intermunicipal community; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

organisations.name: ANJE, national association of young entrepreneurs
organisations.what: National association of young entrepreneurs; partner in ADI and Venture Lab; ran the 2025 Web Summit competition.

organisations.name: Antrix and Carvoeiro Branco: purchase of the Fábrica do Inglês
organisations.what: Two Algarve property developers bought the 1894 cork factory, empty since 2009, to reopen the cork museum, add a boutique hotel and move their offices there. Not AI.

organisations.name: AP Hotels & Resorts
organisations.what: A hotel group whose portfolio includes resorts the release places in Albufeira, named by supplier LodgIQ as a user of its AI revenue management platform.

organisations.name: Artificial Intelligence Algarve
organisations.what: Community that appears as an 'AIA Artificial Intelligence Algarve' category on Algarve Evolution's events page and is listed as AI-related in the BEALG ecosystem directory. The events page showed no event under it when read. Needs its own public page.

organisations.name: Associação de Empresários Por Quarteira
organisations.what: Local business association of Quarteira, a consortium partner for the digital commercial neighbourhood.

organisations.name: Associação de Municípios Loulé/Faro (Estádio Algarve centre)
organisations.what: Joint body of the two councils tendering a technology centre at the Estádio Algarve that names AI among its themes.

organisations.name: Associacao Odiana
organisations.what: Local development association named by the Galp Foundation as social partner in Alcoutim, helping run Vilas em Movimento including its senior-isolation activities. Portuguese partner for the Lower Guadiana in the Agrosocial Plus project.

organisations.name: AuroraMed
organisations.what: Portuguese health-tech company applying AI to clinical management, which launched an AI course with UAlg's medical faculty in Faro.

organisations.name: Ayuntamiento de Ayamonte
organisations.what: Spanish council across the river, in the Eurocidade with VRSA. In March 2024 it said it was preparing an AI virtual assistant and a Eurocidade innovation node. It sits outside the municipality and is listed as the cross-border neighbour.

organisations.name: B.Efficient
organisations.what: Runs EMARP's active leak-detection campaign over 130 km of the public water network. Its location is not stated in the source.

organisations.name: Bairro Comercial Digital de Quarteira (Câmara de Loulé, ACRAL, IAPMEI)
organisations.what: A PRR project of 1.01 million euros, 2023 to 2025, for online shops, a digital tourist guide and smart signage, run by the Loulé council with the Algarve commerce association ACRAL.

organisations.name: Bot Gonçalves
organisations.what: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP company that uses AI and satellite imagery to monitor critical infrastructure. The article gives no town: needs a primary source.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Castro Marim
organisations.what: The council is introducing a digital planning document system and, per the vendor, plans an online planning service with AI. Its own urbanismo page lists a GeoPortal and online services and does not mention AI.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Faro
organisations.what: The council lists a month-long AI-themed library event and an AI exhibition in November 2026. It also updates its urban-planning submission platform, with no AI use stated.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Lagos
organisations.what: Co-organised DevFest Lagos 2025 and the International Women's Day Build with AI event, which was held in its Town Hall, and co-organised the 2025 Algarve Tech Hub Summit.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Loulé
organisations.what: The municipality says it has contracted AI tools for planning cases.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Monchique (general channels)
organisations.what: The council's general telephone, email and postal address, as published on its contacts page. The page lists no separate channel for the entrepreneurship office or the incubator.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Olhão
organisations.what: Council that said in 2023 it was working on AI-optimised waste routes and smart parking, and in 2026 launched the digital commerce project Olhão com Alma.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Portimão
organisations.what: Is rolling out an online urban-management platform with an AI module that checks licensing documents on submission, and has an approved digital-transformation grant that lists AI among its areas.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Silves
organisations.what: The municipal council. It co-hosts the free Formação + Próxima training for the local tourism sector, which included an advanced AI-for-business course in March 2026, and it runs the GEL entrepreneurship office.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Tavira
organisations.what: The council is a partner in the Algarve 6.0 urban management data platform and runs parking sensors linked to the Acessibilidades 360 app.

organisations.name: Camara Municipal de Vila do Bispo
organisations.what: The council's published general office channels, as listed on its own contacts page. For business and funding questions, start here.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Vila Real de Santo António
organisations.what: The council runs the VRSA Digital project (Wi-Fi, footfall counters, online marketplace), a municipal Geoportal launched in January 2025 and a new digital platform for the 2026/2027 school activity offer.

organisations.name: Cáritas Diocesana do Algarve
organisations.what: Held an AI and human dignity conference at Faro's Seminário de São José on 29 October 2026.

organisations.name: CASULO, social innovation incubator
organisations.what: Listed for Loulé by BeAlgarve as an incubator of social innovation.

organisations.name: CCDesert, Centro de Competencias na Luta contra a Desertificacao
organisations.what: A national competence centre hosted by Alcoutim since 2018, joining the Government and more than 30 institutions in research, training and knowledge transfer on desertification, and publishing results digitally. It is also named as a partner of the Robotics4Farmers consortium.

organisations.name: CCDR Algarve
organisations.what: The Algarve's regional development body. Started its first AI course for its own staff in October 2025, 21 hours with ISCTE and funded by Algarve 2030. The page does not state its base city.

organisations.name: Celeiro de Ideias (former EPAC granary business centre)
organisations.what: Municipal project to rehabilitate the old granary beside the EN 122.1 as an entrepreneurship and coworking centre, completion planned for 30 September 2028.

organisations.name: Celeiro de Ideias business and coworking centre (planned)
organisations.what: A future centre for microbusinesses, freelancers, startups and artisans in the former EPAC granary, with entrepreneurship support services. Works are due to finish on 30 September 2028, so it is not open yet.

organisations.name: Celerator, Parque Tecnológico do Algarve
organisations.what: Association of Parkalgar and UAlg behind a technology hub beside the Autódromo, on mobility and energy research. Its rector links the planned UAlg campus to it for technology transfer. No AI work of its own is stated in the sources read.

organisations.name: Centro Ciência Viva de Tavira
organisations.what: Science centre that co-hosted, with the IPMA mollusc research station and council support, a regional school meeting of the ROV4ALL project in May 2022, where students built small remotely operated underwater robots.

organisations.name: Centro de Negócios e Incubadora Level Up
organisations.what: Business centre and incubator in central Tavira, run by the municipal company EMPET, housing the town's Espaço Empresa service point (gov.pt) and listed as an accredited incubator on IAPMEI's November 2018 Vale Incubação list.

organisations.name: CEOT (Centro de Eletrónica, Optoelectrónica e Telecomunicações, UAlg)
organisations.what: UAlg research centre that co-organised a 2024 workshop on deep learning for NIR chemometrics, AI applied to food control.

organisations.name: CIAC (UAlg research centre in arts and communication)
organisations.what: UAlg centre that opened the INTERFACE digital translation lab in Faro in October 2026, with an AI Studio extension at its Santarém hub.

organisations.name: CIMA, Universidade do Algarve (SIMPATICO monitoring buoy)
organisations.what: The University of the Algarve's marine and environmental research centre runs SIMPATICO, an autonomous buoy at the mouth of the Guadiana estuary on the Portugal and Spain border. It has recorded currents, water level and water quality every hour and every 15 minutes since March 2008, and the data are open on PANGAEA. The centre is based at the university, not in the municipality.

organisations.name: CITAI-FABXR ISMAT
organisations.what: ISMAT research and making group that runs the Fabricating Futures workshop on 3D printing, biofabrication and advanced manufacturing.

organisations.name: CME (digital platform for the Alcoutim shared bikes)
organisations.what: The company named as developer of the digital management and usage platform of the shared electric bikes opened in June 2026.

organisations.name: CoLagos, municipal coworking space
organisations.what: Run with the Lagos Youth Association (A)Garra in the old town, 20 workstations, partner of DevFest Lagos 2025.

organisations.name: Council online services, regulations and municipal fees
organisations.what: The council's online services portal, its regulations in force and its table of municipal fees, linked from the same business page.

organisations.name: Cowork Aljezur
organisations.what: Described in an Outsite guide (June 2026) as a small, community-oriented coworking space near Praia do Amado. Other listings say Aljezur has no coworking, so its status needs checking.

organisations.name: Coworking spaces in São Marcos da Serra and São Bartolomeu de Messines
organisations.what: The council says it opened these at the end of 2021. A 2025 opinion column said Silves had no incubator, accelerator or business centre, so we could confirm none of those.

organisations.name: CRESC Algarve 2020 (FEDER) funding for the Celerator technology hub
organisations.what: 4 million euros of European funds in a 7.2 million euro mobility and energy technology hub beside the Autódromo, run by Parkalgar and UAlg. No AI work is stated.

organisations.name: CRESC Algarve 2020, funding for Sea4Us
organisations.what: About 1.3 million euros of regional programme funding reported for Sea4Us.

organisations.name: CRIA (UAlg entrepreneurship and technology transfer division)
organisations.what: Runs UAlg's proof-of-concept validation programme for technology projects at maturity levels 3 to 6 (June 2026 call) and the Ideias em Caixa business-idea competition, with Algarve Evolution, Algarve STP, ANJE, AMAL and NERA.

organisations.name: Dengun
organisations.what: An Algarve-based company whose chief executive said in May 2026 that it plans to create 150 technology companies in the region within seven years and that the region lacks AI computing capacity. Its base city is not stated on the page we read.

organisations.name: DETAILS, Hospitality, Sports, Leisure (Arrow Global, Vilamoura)
organisations.what: Manages Arrow Global's hospitality, sports and leisure assets in Portugal, including Vilamoura's golf courses, and brought Trackman ball tracking to the Old Course in 2025.

organisations.name: DigiATLA
organisations.what: Interreg Atlantic Area project (1 January 2026 to 30 June 2028, about EUR 2.13 million) on digital capacity and precision nutrition in aquaculture, led by S2AQUA with SPAROS, IPMA and universities in Vigo, Galway and France.

organisations.name: Digital Commerce Accelerator, local actions in São Brás
organisations.what: Recovery-plan programme led by the Algarve business association, run locally under a protocol with the council.

organisations.name: Digital-transformation grant, call ALGARVE-2025-13
organisations.what: Approved investment for the council's digital services, covering infrastructure, security, Wi-Fi and automation, with AI listed among the project areas.

organisations.name: Digital-transition funding calls listed by the council
organisations.what: The council's calls page lists national funding such as Smart PME (Industry 4.0), Coaching 4.0 and vouchers for startups with green and digital products. The titles name no AI and the page gives no dates, so check each call at its source.

organisations.name: DigitalGTPro
organisations.what: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP company that automates business processes and supports data-driven decisions. The article gives no town.

organisations.name: DRAP Algarve, Centro de Experimentação Agrária de Tavira (CEAT)
organisations.what: The regional agriculture and fisheries directorate manages the CEAT in Tavira, the site that anchors the Polo de Inovação and its Mediterranean Diet research.

organisations.name: DSPA (Data Science Portuguese Association)
organisations.what: National association for data science and AI that is listed as a member of Algarve Evolution. Its own site lists a generative AI certification, an AI Act compliance programme for businesses, an AI agents day for executives and the annual INSIGHTS conference. The site states no Algarve link: it appears on the map because of the membership.

organisations.name: dstelecom
organisations.what: Fibre infrastructure operator extending its network in Alcoutim, Giões and Pereiro.

organisations.name: Edifício Multifuncional de Empresas (EME), Câmara Municipal de Castro Marim
organisations.what: The council's business hub with individual offices, shared spaces, meeting rooms, wireless internet and incubation support, for entrepreneurs with innovative, scalable ideas who want their headquarters in Castro Marim. The council publishes the operating regulation, an application form and an information leaflet.

organisations.name: Edit'AI
organisations.what: Publisher of the founders' book with AI prompts that was presented at UALG TEC Campus in Faro on 30 September 2026.

organisations.name: EDP (solar and wind in Aljezur)
organisations.what: Operates the 24 MW Bordeira wind farm and a new 15.3 MW solar plant beside it in Aljezur.

organisations.name: Elevated Design
organisations.what: Algarve studio that builds websites, AI chatbots and workflow automation for local businesses, and names Lagos among the towns it serves. Its page states no Lagos office, so this is a company serving Lagos, not one confirmed based there.

organisations.name: EMARP (Portimão municipal water and waste company)
organisations.what: Bought 20 AI acoustic loggers to monitor the water network for leaks and run two Fundo Ambiental leak-control projects.

organisations.name: Empowered Startups
organisations.what: Partner of UAlg in building an Algarve AI cluster and Platinum sponsor of the EPIA 2025 AI conference.

organisations.name: ePaper by Mind (vendor whose client logos include Loulé)
organisations.what: Mind's digital urban-planning platform. Its page shows a 'Loulé' logo among 27 municipal client logos and names AI features: document checks at online reception, an AI error check before a request is filed, and an AI agent announced on 13 October 2026. The page says nothing about what Loulé uses, and the council has not named the AI tools it contracted for planning, so we do not link the two. Found by detective.places@ and read by us on 16 November 2026.

organisations.name: Escola de Hotelaria e Turismo de Portimão
organisations.what: Hospitality school that hosted the February 2026 presentation of the AI como Copiloto book and was engaged around the TMCT conference.

organisations.name: Espaço Coworking São Brás de Alportel
organisations.what: Municipal coworking space for young people opened in August 2020, with five workstations and a meeting room.

organisations.name: Eurocidade do Guadiana (Ayamonte, Vila Real de Santo António, Castro Marim)
organisations.what: Cross-border grouping of three councils that presented a pilot AI avatar video for tourism in January 2024, led by Ayamonte. Castro Marim's council president took part.

organisations.name: European funds behind SPIC's AI.EVENT
organisations.what: RTP says SPIC's AI platform for reading audience reactions has had European funding. It names no programme or amount.

organisations.name: European Innovation Council Accelerator, investment in Sea4Us
organisations.what: About 5.6 million euros from the EIC Accelerator for the Sagres marine biotech company, as reported by Barlavento in December 2023.

organisations.name: expressTEC
organisations.what: Faro biotech startup spun out of UAlg research, building an RNA-based test to guide cancer therapy, with machine-learning software that produces the clinical report.

organisations.name: Fábrica do Empreendedor de Lagos
organisations.what: Free support for entrepreneurs, companies and individuals (employment, training, starting a business), promoted by the social entrepreneurs agency SEA with the Lagos council as social investor. Its Lagos office moved to the marina area in 2021. Also a partner of DevFest Lagos 2025.

organisations.name: Faculdade de Ciências e Tecnologia (FCT-UAlg)
organisations.what: UAlg faculty named as the contact for EPIA 2025, the 24th Portuguese conference on AI, held at the Gambelas campus in Faro on 1 to 3 October 2025.

organisations.name: Faro council: business incubation (a business nest managed by ANJE)
organisations.what: Spaces for microenterprises and emerging projects of young entrepreneurs. The page names no services, price, sector or application channel, and points to IEFP and CRIA at the University of Algarve.

organisations.name: Faro council: Desenvolvimento económico (Faro Invest)
organisations.what: The council's economic development desk lists technological and business innovation as a priority and names spin-offs from the University of Algarve, strategic and individual investors and service entrepreneurs as its audiences. Meetings are by appointment.

organisations.name: Flow Productions
organisations.what: Organised the July 2026 hybrid panel at UALG TEC Campus on AI search and company visibility, with Algarve STP.

organisations.name: FMCB-UAlg (Faculty of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences)
organisations.what: Co-runs the executive course on AI in healthcare with AuroraMed, held in Faro.

organisations.name: Fosteam@South, Recovery and Resilience funding for the Sagres marine laboratory
organisations.what: About 2.1 million euros of Recovery and Resilience Plan money for the Universidade do Algarve, CCMAR and municipality marine biology laboratory at Porto da Baleeira, as reported in June 2023.

organisations.name: FULGUR-IT
organisations.what: Technology-based company in Olhão with solutions for agriculture, industry and smart cities, per its Portugal 2020 funding record for an internationalisation diagnosis.

organisations.name: Fundacao Galp (Vilas em Movimento)
organisations.what: Social investment in Alcoutim's shared electric bikes, with the Odiana association and the council.

organisations.name: Fundo Ambiental, EMARP leak-control projects
organisations.what: Funds two leak-detection projects of the municipal water company, including the AI acoustic loggers.

organisations.name: Gabinete de Empreendedorismo (council business desk)
organisations.what: Created January 2022. Prepares funding applications for businesses and public bodies, tracks funding lines, prepares feasibility studies and supports investors.

organisations.name: GDG Faro
organisations.what: Independent, community-run developer meetup in Faro. Runs DevFest 2026 and ran an AI hackathon on Gemma on 18 July 2026.

organisations.name: GDG Lagos (Google Developer Group)
organisations.what: Runs AI talks and workshops at The Collab Bar and the Town Hall, including Build with AI, an agents talk and DevFest Lagos.

organisations.name: Geek Girls Faro
organisations.what: Faro chapter of Geek Girls Portugal, which held an event in 2019 on women in AI and tech. We found nothing newer.

organisations.name: GEL, the council's local entrepreneurship office
organisations.what: Informs entrepreneurs about support, links them to public or private institutions, advises on the rules for EU and other funding, and helps local producers.

organisations.name: Guepardo
organisations.what: Listed by the StartUP Portimão incubator as developing V2X (vehicle-to-everything) and AI products to improve road mobility and traffic coordination. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni. We found no independent reporting on its products, funding or deployments.

organisations.name: Horizon 2020 SME Instrument phase 1, Sea4Pain feasibility study
organisations.what: EU contribution of 50,000 euros (total cost 71,429 euros) to Sea4Us for a feasibility study, 1 May to 30 September 2018.

organisations.name: Horizon Europe, Teaming for Excellence (European Commission) into UAlgTec Heritage
organisations.what: 15 million euros of the 31.5 million euro package for the University of Algarve's archaeology centre ICArEHB.

organisations.name: ICArEHB (UAlg research centre)
organisations.what: UAlg archaeology research centre behind UAlgTec Heritage, funded with 31.5 million euros to use AI in heritage protection.

organisations.name: Ideias em Caixa (UAlg and CRIA)
organisations.what: Business-idea competition: 40 ideas get maturation sessions and the top idea in each of eight categories wins 5,000 euros. Open to over 18s and firms under three years old (8th edition, 2024 to 2025).

organisations.name: Incubadora de Empresas de Monchique (IEM)
organisations.what: The municipal business incubator, listed by the council among its co-financed projects (Vale incubadoras e aceleradoras). It hosts Invisible CFO and says it aims to attract and support companies that settle in Monchique and create jobs.

organisations.name: InovaPrime
organisations.what: Local information technology company that presented its activity at the council's sixth business ideas forum on 27 October 2026.

organisations.name: Instituto Politécnico de Beja, partner of the Lagoa air quality work
organisations.what: Based in Beja, not in Lagoa: listed because its teachers plan a scientific paper with Lagoa council as institutional partner.

organisations.name: Instituto Superior Tecnico (Robotics4Farmers partner)
organisations.what: Lisbon engineering school, a named partner of the Robotics4Farmers consortium that includes Alcoutim's council. Not based in Alcoutim.

organisations.name: International Sci-Tech Innovation Competition (information session at UALG TEC Campus, 21 July 2026)
organisations.what: A China and Portuguese- and Spanish-speaking countries contest with prizes up to about 25 million euros across 100 projects, run by two chambers of commerce with Algarve Evolution. Winners can reach over 50 investment funds in the Greater Bay Area. No deadline stated.

organisations.name: Interreg Spain-Portugal and FEDER in Agrosocial Plus
organisations.what: Cross-border funding of the project in which Odiana represents the Lower Guadiana and Living Labs will test AI and IoT.

organisations.name: INTREPIDA pro
organisations.what: Cross-border Interreg Spain-Portugal project led by Fundación Tres Culturas del Mediterráneo, with NERA as partner. It supported the 10 November Lunch & Learn on AI tools in Faro.

organisations.name: Invisible CFO
organisations.what: Portuguese fintech founded in 2024 and based in Monchique, a digital finance provider for small businesses and freelancers. By its own account it combines AI, automation and a human team, and says 300,000 euros of EU funding helped develop its AI and automation applications. Named an Impact Startup 2025.

organisations.name: IPMA, Estação Piloto de Piscicultura de Olhão (EPPO)
organisations.what: National pilot fish-farming station at Marim in the Ria Formosa Natural Park, for research, pilot-scale demonstration and technology transfer to industry.

organisations.name: ISMAT, Instituto Superior Manuel Teixeira Gomes
organisations.what: Higher-education institution in Portimão run by COFAC. Its computer engineering degree has a 6 ECTS Inteligência Artificial unit in the third year.

organisations.name: JFA Training
organisations.what: Training and consulting firm applying the Kaizen method, listed in the StartUP Portimão incubator. Two speakers from it appeared on the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni.

organisations.name: Junior Achievement Portugal
organisations.what: Runs 'The Company' with Algarve Evolution's education work.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Aljezur
organisations.what: The parish council that launched the Gota Aljezur teleassistance pilot with Tecnologias Imaginadas.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Ferragudo
organisations.what: The parish council runs Ferrukas, an AI virtual assistant on its website, and an official app. A PRR-funded digital neighbourhood project is under way in the village.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Quarteira
organisations.what: The parish council of Quarteira, a partner in the digital commercial neighbourhood consortium.

organisations.name: Jupiter Hotel Group (Jupiter Albufeira Hotel)
organisations.what: A hotel group with a hotel in Albufeira that the vendor Quinta lists as a user of its AI guest communication app.

organisations.name: KIPT CoLab
organisations.what: Consortium partner in INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Its own role in AI is not yet sourced.

organisations.name: KTTSeaDrones (cross-border Spain and Portugal project, with a Sagres pilot)
organisations.what: A POCTEP research project on aerial and aquatic drones and fixed sensors for marine and fisheries science, led by the Universidad de Huelva, with CCMAR and CINTAL as Algarve partners and a pilot at Sagres. A search result describing its technical report says its software layer used computer vision and AI to detect fish. We could not open the report (it returned errors), so the AI claim is unverified.

organisations.name: Lagos Digital Nomads
organisations.what: Started by a local entrepreneur in 2020 or 2021 during the pandemic, it links the town's digital nomads with local businesses through a website, networking events and workshops. Media partner of the Women's Day AI event.

organisations.name: Lagos Remoters
organisations.what: A community of Lagos remote workers, listed as a partner and media partner of the International Women's Day Build with AI event.

organisations.name: LeiGPT
organisations.what: AI platform for lawyers on Portuguese law, registered in Faro and a member of Algarve Evolution, which its site lists with Google for Startups and Akamai among its partners and supporters. It answers legal research questions with citations to codes and court rulings, analyses documents, and runs as a cloud service or on a client's own servers. Available now, with a free one-day trial.

organisations.name: Liceu Azul
organisations.what: New school project in Aljezur with secondary education in Sciences and Technologies, due to open in September 2026, with a research centre on innovative teaching.

organisations.name: LOFT Community
organisations.what: Community of remote workers, digital nomads and entrepreneurs across Loulé, Olhão, Faro and Tavira. Its collaborators include Algarve Evolution, Tavira Works, GDG, the Algarve Blockchain Community, GeekSessions and the 351 Startup Association. No AI event is listed on its page.

organisations.name: Loulé and Faro multi-technology centre, Estádio Algarve (planned)
organisations.what: A tendered centre of about 2,235 square metres for companies and startups. Proposals were due on 2 November 2026 and the work has 12 months to run.

organisations.name: Loulé Concelho Global
organisations.what: Named as a partner in the Quarteira digital commercial neighbourhood consortium.

organisations.name: Loulé Design Lab (Loulé Criativo)
organisations.what: Municipal creative and technology incubator and coworking space, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI programme found yet.

organisations.name: Lovable
organisations.what: AI app-building company whose tool powered the sold-out Vibathon Algarve of 31 October 2026, co-organised with Algarve Evolution (per our newsroom).

organisations.name: MARREAL underwater observatory, Sagres (UAlg, CINTAL, CCMAR, INESC-TEC)
organisations.what: An observatory installed in October 2022 at about 20 metres depth off Sagres, with an underwater video camera, a temperature and salinity sensor, a particle sensor and an underwater noise sensor. It records data in real time, to be put online. An initiative of the Tec4Sea research infrastructure, with the KTTSeaDrones project joining.

organisations.name: Mentors and partner network of StartUP Portimão
organisations.what: In 2022 the incubator reported more than 40 mentors, more than 45 partner entities and 25 startups hosted. Its site has sections for national and local partners, an advisory board and mentors.

organisations.name: Mind (ePaper)
organisations.what: Portuguese software vendor whose ePaper urban planning system is going into Castro Marim. It also markets an AI agent, Agente ePaper IA, that answers planning questions in natural language, reported on its own news page on 13 October 2026.

organisations.name: Modernizacao e Digitalizacao do Municipio de Alcoutim (Algarve 2030 project)
organisations.what: Council project to strengthen IT infrastructure and cybersecurity, digitise internal processes, open online services and train staff, due 30 June 2028.

organisations.name: MTI (Managing The Intelligence)
organisations.what: UAlg spin-off founded in October 2019 and based at UALG TEC Campus. Sensors and a web app switch off hotel room air conditioning when a window opens or a room is empty. Backed by Portugal Ventures.

organisations.name: Municipal tax exemptions for innovative or creative investment
organisations.what: The council says it has granted tax exemptions since at least mid-2017 to investment projects such as innovative or creative activities, job creation, local products and energy efficiency.

organisations.name: Município de Albufeira
organisations.what: The council says it uses an AI-based urban management platform, and it runs a smart city portal for occurrence management.

organisations.name: Municipio de Alcoutim
organisations.what: The council's published general office channel and opening hours.

organisations.name: Municipio de Aljezur
organisations.what: The council runs an online services portal, an interactive municipal map, a GEO Portal and a tourist app. We found no AI use.

organisations.name: Município de Lagoa, SmartCity:Lagoa
organisations.what: The council runs a Smart City portal and an AI air quality prototype built with a polytechnic student, and its IT coordinator has spoken publicly about AI limits in local government.

organisations.name: Município de São Brás de Alportel
organisations.what: Local council, partner in the Algarve 6.0 smart territory project, supporter of University of Algarve research, host of the town's entrepreneurship programme.

organisations.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, digitalisation of municipal services
organisations.what: The council's own project sheet (approved 9 October 2025, running 1 July 2022 to 31 December 2027): strengthen the technology and network infrastructure for more capacity and reliability, described as technological modernisation and digital transformation of local administration. Eligible cost 1,072,637.94 euros, EU support 643,582.75 euros.

organisations.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, smart urban waste management
organisations.what: The council's project sheet (approved 21 November 2025, 1 June 2024 to 31 December 2025): reinforce and optimise separate waste collection, with efficiency, 'intelligent' waste management and bio-waste collection. Eligible cost 439,725 euros, EU support 263,835 euros.

organisations.name: Nautiber, Estaleiros Navais do Guadiana
organisations.what: Shipyard on the Guadiana in Vila Real de Santo António. In 2021 it launched the 19 metre research vessel «Mar Profundo» for INESC TEC and CINTAL (University of Algarve), meant for testing marine robots, sensors and unmanned underwater vehicles. In December 2025 it said it plans a defence unit aimed at unmanned systems, with the structure of four surface drones already delivered, and the site undecided between VRSA, Portimão and Lagos. Visited in February 2026 as part of the council's blue economy push.

organisations.name: Neomarca
organisations.what: SME consultancy operating since 1995 with its head office in Faro and a team in Porto, and a member of Algarve Evolution. Its digital transformation work includes a service called digitalisation and adoption of artificial intelligence, alongside funding advice for programmes such as PRR and Portugal 2030.

organisations.name: NERA, Associação Empresarial da Região do Algarve
organisations.what: Regional business association headquartered in Loulé. It leads the Inova Algarve 3.0 consortium and runs AI tool training sessions and courses in November 2026.

organisations.name: NILG.AI (partner of ALGAR)
organisations.what: Start-up incubated at UPTEC, the University of Porto's science park, that co-built ALGAR's AI recycling-point tool. Not a Loulé firm: it is listed as ALGAR's partner.

organisations.name: Ninho de Empreendedorismo 4 Olhos
organisations.what: Second municipal Ninho listed on the council's incubation page, supporting local founders with a space and resources.

organisations.name: Ninho de Empreendedorismo da Vila
organisations.what: Municipal incubation space in the village square, with one individual office, three coworking desks, two spaces for digital nomads and a meeting room.

organisations.name: Ninho de Empresas de Loulé (IEFP)
organisations.what: Public business and technology incubator, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI tenants found yet.

organisations.name: Nobel Algarve British International School
organisations.what: A school in Lagoa that was the venue and a partner of the Lagoa Teens AI Design Sprint, a two-day AI hackathon for students aged 12 to 18, on 21 and 22 February 2026.

organisations.name: NOVA IMS and the Lagos council smart cities protocol
organisations.what: A three-year protocol signed in September 2021 for smart-city research and data management. The article does not mention AI.

organisations.name: NOVA LINCS, UAlg pole (engineering laboratory, Campus da Penha)
organisations.what: A UAlg research centre in Faro. A November 2025 call for a one-year research grant starting in January 2026 places the work there, on the AI.INSIGHTS project (AI-powered real-time anonymous user monitoring), funded by Algarve FEDER, seeking computer vision and AI skills.

organisations.name: Odiana, Baixo Guadiana development association
organisations.what: Association that represents the Baixo Guadiana in the cooperation network of Agrosocial Plus, a 2,062,429.85 euro Interreg Spain-Portugal project, funded 75 percent by ERDF, whose Living Labs will test AI, IoT and smart irrigation. The article does not say whether Vila Real de Santo António is part of the project.

organisations.name: Parkalgar
organisations.what: Manages the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve in Portimão, is a member of the Celerator technology park association with the University of Algarve, and was engaged around the TMCT conference.

organisations.name: Peanuts
organisations.what: Local marketing and digital content project on the council's entrepreneur showcase (page 4 of 4).

organisations.name: Pitch & Match
organisations.what: A session at StartUP Portimão's ninth anniversary on 10 August 2026 meant to connect entrepreneurs, business people, mentors and potential investors. No investor organisation is named in the report.

organisations.name: Polo de Inovação de Tavira
organisations.what: Research, innovation and technology-transfer hub on the Mediterranean Diet, health, sustainable food and climate adaptation, funded by the PRR (1.36 million euros, 3 January 2022 to 31 December 2025), with the CCDR Algarve as direct beneficiary. It includes lab equipment and a collection of about 700 fruit and grape varieties. At its November 2021 launch it had 23 partners, among them DRAP Algarve, the Município de Tavira, Ciência Viva, the Algarve Biomedical Center and Johns Hopkins University, and plans for a digital therapeutics centre and virtual-reality training.

organisations.name: Portimão Cowork Space
organisations.what: Council coworking space whose entrepreneurs were expected at the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel.

organisations.name: Portugal 2030 and Algarve 2030, digitalisation of municipal services
organisations.what: EU support of 643,582.75 euros to the Municipality of Vila do Bispo on an eligible cost of 1,072,637.94 euros, project ALGARVE-FEDER-03054600.

organisations.name: Portugal 2030 and Algarve 2030, smart urban waste management
organisations.what: EU support of 263,835 euros to the Municipality of Vila do Bispo on an eligible cost of 439,725 euros, project ALGARVE-FEDER-03085500.

organisations.name: Portugal Ventures into MTI (Managing The Intelligence)
organisations.what: Invested more than half a million euros in MTI, a UAlg spin-off at UALG TEC Campus that automates hotel air conditioning. The source ties the original research to AI (genetic algorithms) but does not say how the product uses AI today.

organisations.name: PRR funding for the Algarve 6.0 Smart Territorial Hub
organisations.what: Non-refundable PRR funding for the six-municipality sensor and data platform.

organisations.name: PRR scholarships for the AuroraMed and UAlg AI course
organisations.what: Recovery plan funding covered the full fee for selected participants of the April 2026 executive course on AI in health.

organisations.name: Quarteira Lab (Câmara Municipal de Loulé, with Fundo Ambiental)
organisations.what: A decarbonisation living lab around Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto, co-financed by the Fundo Ambiental, with a people and bicycle counter feeding a data platform.

organisations.name: Radar Social (PRR pilot, Alcoutim council)
organisations.what: A PRR-funded social response with a two-person team and 169,302.59 euros. Its second phase, due to run to March 2026, sets up a social georeferencing system to locate people and families at risk and the resources around them.

organisations.name: Re-Source 3.0 (Sociedade Ponto Verde) behind ALGAR's AI tool
organisations.what: The programme under which ALGAR and NILG.AI built the AI recycling-point tool. One report puts the investment at 50 thousand euros.

organisations.name: REAVER (PRR, Municipio de Alcoutim as beneficiary)
organisations.what: A council project on how sustainable forest production and agroforestry can reverse desertification and the effects of depopulation, by quantifying the value of ecosystem services. 124,800 euros of EU support, 6 September 2022 to 31 December 2025.

organisations.name: Regional funding call for the UAlg technology campus
organisations.what: A call of 10 million euros at 60% funding, with the application to ALGARVE 2030 expected around February 2025, for a campus whose focus areas are digital, data and AI. Funding was not fully secured at the time of the report.

organisations.name: Robotics4Farmers (PRR agenda, with Municipio de Alcoutim as a named partner)
organisations.what: An 11-partner consortium building collaborative, intelligent, eco-efficient farm robots, first for vines, olives and almonds, with a herbicide-free solar-heat weeding platform. The council's own project sheet lists the Municipio de Alcoutim among the beneficiaries and gives the region of intervention as Portugal (Alcoutim). It ran from 1 May 2022 to 30 September 2025 with 117,760.56 euros of EU support. The project page names Instituto Superior Tecnico, the desertification centre and an Elvas olive growers association among its partners.

organisations.name: S2AQUAcoLAB
organisations.what: Collaborative laboratory for sustainable and smart aquaculture, founded in 2021 and based in Olhão. It lists technological developments, from robotics to AI, among its research lines, and leads DigiATLA.

organisations.name: SalOS
organisations.what: Traceability and operations platform for artisanal salt producers, born inside the Sapal de Castro Marim reserve, with a free 30 day trial. Press describes a digital assistant and a salinity and sluice support tool.

organisations.name: Savvy Alpha
organisations.what: Local business in medical equipment and technology, presented at the council's sixth business ideas forum on 27 October 2026.

organisations.name: Sea4Us
organisations.what: Marine biotechnology company in Sagres that develops drugs from marine compounds, led by a chronic pain candidate called Sea4Pain. Spin-off of Nova Medical School, working from Porto da Baleeira.

organisations.name: SheSapiens
organisations.what: A women's community that ran an AI productivity workshop in Lagos on 14 October 2026 and was a partner of the 2025 International Women's Day Build with AI evening in the Lagos Town Hall.

organisations.name: Sociedade da Água de Monchique (Água Monchique)
organisations.what: Mineral water producer with its plant at Caldas de Monchique. Its own pages describe a digital strategy, the myMonchique app, a smart water dispenser shown in 2021 and an automated logistics centre. It states it already uses some AI tools, unspecified.

organisations.name: SPAROS Lda
organisations.what: Aquafeed company in Olhão with a PRR-funded project, IA@SPAROS, to bring AI tools into feed production and into decisions on data, science and administration.

organisations.name: SPIC
organisations.what: A digital studio based in the Algarve (the page does not name the town) with an R&D consortium with UAlg. In 2023 it used AI trained on more than 9,000 records to build a stage hologram for the band D'ZRT.

organisations.name: StartUP Portimão
organisations.what: Business incubator at the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, opened in 2017 by the council, the Autódromo and Territórios Criativos, focused on smart cities, energy, mobility and tourism. In 2022 it reported 25 startups hosted. It promoted the June 2026 Future Business Summit with an AI panel.

organisations.name: StartUP Portimão acceleration programme
organisations.what: The 7th edition of the incubator's accelerator for entrepreneurs and business projects in the Algarve: skills, stronger business models and new market opportunities. Applications closed on 28 October 2026, with a first online bootcamp on 2 and 3 November and a second in person in Portimão on 24 and 25 November 2026. No AI theme is stated.

organisations.name: Startup Portugal
organisations.what: Recognised the incubator in January 2026.

organisations.name: Strong Answer
organisations.what: An IT company in Lagoa, with more than 25 years in business by its own account, selling consulting, cloud, cybersecurity and business software, and AI agents that read mail, sort urgent items and draft replies while a person approves the final action.

organisations.name: Substância3D
organisations.what: Local 3D services business listed with We Stream Algarve on the council's entrepreneur showcase.

organisations.name: Tavira Works
organisations.what: Community whose own landing page says it aims to cultivate entrepreneurship and innovation in Tavira. Listed by name in the Algarve Tech Hub network (CCDR Algarve slides, July 2025) and as a collaborator of LOFT. The page names no organisers or events.

organisations.name: Tecnilab
organisations.what: Supplier of the AI acoustic loggers bought by EMARP. Its own location is not stated in the source.

organisations.name: Tecnologias Imaginadas
organisations.what: Company behind the Gota Click2Care teleassistance device used in the parish of Aljezur's pilot. Its base is not stated in the source.

organisations.name: Territórios Criativos
organisations.what: Partner of StartUP Portimão's founding and moderator of the February 2026 AI como Copiloto debate.

organisations.name: Tertúlia Algarvia
organisations.what: Consortium partner in INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Its own role in AI is not yet sourced.

organisations.name: The Collab Bar
organisations.what: Bar venue on Avenida dos Descobrimentos that hosts GDG Lagos AI talks.

organisations.name: Thinkerdots Technologies
organisations.what: IT consulting and information-systems company listed in the StartUP Portimão incubator. A speaker from it appeared on the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni.

organisations.name: Turismo do Algarve (Região de Turismo do Algarve)
organisations.what: Regional tourism body that runs the Competências do Futuro Algarve programme, including a free AI bootcamp for tourism professionals, and is an INOVA ALGARVE 3.0 partner.

organisations.name: UAlg proof-of-concept programme (CRIA)
organisations.what: Takes technology projects from maturity level 3 to 6 towards demonstration in a real setting. The June 2026 call closed on 10 July.

organisations.name: UALG TEC Campus
organisations.what: The University of Algarve's technology incubator and accelerator on its Penha campus in Faro, opened in March 2022 with about 16 companies and 300 workers, mostly in information technology. It has since hosted the July 2026 AI search panel, the 30 September 2026 founders' book launch and Vibathon Algarve 2026 on 31 October.

organisations.name: ULS Algarve
organisations.what: The Algarve's local health unit, which held a webinar on AI in the national health service on 15 September 2026.

organisations.name: Universidade do Algarve (UAlg)
organisations.what: The Algarve's public university, with its main contact address in Faro. Published an AI use policy on 24 September 2026.

organisations.name: Universidade do Algarve (UAlg), Portimão campus
organisations.what: Has a small existing campus in Portimão and a signed protocol with the council for a new technology-focused campus at Barranco do Rodrigo, with digital, data and AI as focus areas, linked by its rector to research with the Autódromo and Celerator technology park.

organisations.name: Universidade do Algarve and CCMAR, Sagres marine biology laboratory
organisations.what: A teaching and research laboratory at Porto da Baleeira, planned with the municipality and funded by the Fosteam@South project, about 2.1 million euros of Recovery and Resilience money, as reported in June 2023. The Universidade do Algarve's page shows the Sagres Marine Station hosted the Sagres Marine Science Festival from 6 to 9 May 2026, with the municipality as co-organiser.

organisations.name: University of the Algarve (R&D consortium with SPIC)
organisations.what: UAlg's own page says it has a research and development consortium with Loulé's SPIC on information technology and human-interaction research. UAlg's campuses are in Faro and Portimão, so the link here is the partnership.

organisations.name: Venture Lab by Algarve STP
organisations.what: Free mentoring for 12 validated Algarve startups and SMEs, funded by Algarve 2030. The 2026 call closed on 24 June.

organisations.name: Vicentina, development association of the southwest (LEADER local action group, Adere programmes)
organisations.what: Regional development association whose funding calls have covered Vila do Bispo with Aljezur and Monchique. A 2020 call, +CO3SO Emprego Interior, funded job creation including self-employment in micro and small firms in low-density areas, 2.0 million euros across three measures. The call is old, so check what is open now.

organisations.name: Vilamoura World (Arrow Global), developer and marina operator
organisations.what: Develops Vilamoura and its new 68-berth marina, designed with remote monitoring of water and electricity use at the berths and charging points for electric boats (reported January 2024).

organisations.name: We Stream Algarve
organisations.what: Local business on the council's 'Os nossos Empreendedores' page (page 3 of 4), listed together with Substância3D as 3D and streaming services, described there in terms of technology, communication, online work and digital solutions.

organisations.name: Zoomarine Algarve
organisations.what: Visitor attraction named as one of the stakeholders engaged around the TMCT conference. Its exact role is not stated in the source.
